paper.title: Planning and Learning in Risk-Aware Restless Multi-Arm Bandits

settings.out_of_scope_reason: Restless multi-arm bandit where each arm is an MDP with unknown transition probabilities; episodic Markovian setting (markovian environments out of scope in v0.5).
unmapped: each arm is a finite-state MDP with unknown transitions; agent observes states of all arms
at most M of N arms activated per round (budget on activations)
risk-aware objective: sum over arms of utility U^i of each arm's total episode reward
episodic: K episodes of length T; regret compared with the optimal risk-aware policy
learner knows reward functions, utility functions and initial states
settings.definition_quote: Problem LRRMAB: (Learning Risk-Aware RMAB) Given time horizon T, and a set of N arms (X^i, A, r^i, x^i_0), i in N where at most M < N of them can be activated at a time, find a sequence of {pi^k}_{k>=1} that minimizes R(K).

algorithms.name: LRAP-TS (Learning Risk-Aware Policy using Thompson Sampling)

symbols.R_max: upper bound on per-step reward of each arm
symbols.X_bar: max_i |X^i|, largest per-arm state space size

conditions: per-arm parameters theta^i lie in compact sets and are independent across arms, drawn from prior

results.notes: Bayesian regret over K episodes against optimal risk-aware policy. Symbols renamed: paper's N arms -> K, T episode length -> H, K episodes -> K_ep. Algorithm computes exact optimal risk-aware policy for sampled parameters, which the paper notes is intractable for large N (hence compute=exponential).
